judged.label: judged
judged.note: Guard 1. Only tests whose referee is outside cnaster count, so this says how much of the subject is validated rather than reached.

oracle.label: oracle surface
oracle.note: Guard 2. Measured over its own denominator so the figure cannot rise by importing more of upstream, which validates nothing about cnaster. Sitting 0.06 points above its floor.

reach.label: reach
reach.selection: not release and not (end2end or oracle)
reach.note: Guard 3. Proposed by #159 and not wired into CI -- its 'Done when' asks for exactly that and it is unmet. #159 last recorded 67.37 per cent on 18 Sep, which predates roughly twenty merged pull requests and is not carried here.

whole_run._intent: run_cnaster patched against --no-patch, wall time and peak RSS, each arm in its own process. key_instance (10,000 x 5,000) does not fit unpatched -- 8 GB of emission array against 15 GB available (#90) -- so the comparison runs at the largest instance both arms complete and the badge label carries it. This measurement is #91.
